founders.name: Ankit Khandelwal
founders.title: Founder
founders.bio: Ankit is the Founder and CEO of GroMo. He is a serial entrepreneur with failures and successful exits. Prior to GroMo, he was Founding Member and COO of Unicommerce (listed on NSE in India), and co-founder of Priyaasi (acquired by Mensa Brands). He graduated from IIT Delhi and has 15+ years of experience in a hedge fund, e-commerce, SaaS, fintech.

founders.name: Darpan Khurana
founders.title: Founder
founders.bio: I am a co-founder at GroMo. Prior to GroMo, I worked with Snapdeal and Housing.com (both backed by Softbank) in various roles across Strategy, and Business Intelligence. I have also worked at Oracle as a Software Engineer. I am interested in emerging trends in Fintech both in India and across the world. I am an avid basketball follower and a big Golden State Warrior fan.
